applied.summary: Corrected mislabeling: '(mutation pitches)' had been applied to octave AND fifth ranks; octaves are not mutations. Reworded so the mutation label applies only to fifth-sounding ranks (standard organ terminology).
Removed material ambiguity: 'cup-shaped brass mute' could read as made of brass, contradicting 'rubber cup'. Changed to 'cup-shaped mute for brass instruments'.
Fixed misplaced referent: 'the strings, whose magnetic pull' wrongly attributed the pull to the strings. Rewrote so the magnets' pull dampens string vibration.
Replaced 'A note that tells you...' (ambiguous with pitch in a string context) with 'A bowing instruction...', matching sibling Sul ponticello. FK grade 5.2.
Replaced out-of-domain 'Stereo keyboard output' (electronic) with 'Free reed' for this acoustic free-reed concept.
Replaced out-of-domain 'Stereo keyboard output' with 'Main pair', keeping the map within the woodwind/ensemble domain.
Fixed faulty parallelism under modal 'can': changed 'and tunes' to 'and tune'.
Removed duplicate device name: 'DI box' and 'Direct box' are the same thing. Replaced 'Direct box' with 'Ground lift'.

Rewrote the garbled, redundant final sentence ('Then phones and laptops still show the bass') to 'So even on a phone speaker, listeners can still follow the bassline.' FK grade 4.7. Resolves both the cognition and language flags.

Removed internal contradiction: plain_english said flipping a switch 'fixes this', the exact oversimplification the definition and common_mistakes warn against. Added that timing sometimes also needs a nudge. FK grade 5.3.
Added missing article: 'cups mic and harp' -> 'cups the mic and harp', matching the sibling scenario.
Removed metal/brass ambiguity: 'A hollow metal brass mute' -> 'A hollow metal mute for brass instruments'.
Fixed subject-verb agreement with the compound subject: 'breath and vocal-tract control forces' -> 'force'.
